conclusion: no FZ/DN/non-nearest setting found on the traced path
conclusion_detail: Every traced write to FPSCR-bearing state leaves FZ=0, DN=0 and RMode=00 (nearest): the pinned NuttX configures CPACR and FPCCR only, never writes FPDSCR, and starts every non-idle task and pthread with FPSCR 0 in its initial hardware exception frame; the pinned PX4 compiles without -ffast-math, -funsafe-math-optimizations or -Ofast and links the firmware with -nostartfiles, so the toolchain startfile spec cannot add crtfastmath.o (the only object that sets FZ); the only FPSCR-writing library members (newlib fenv functions) are unreferenced. The trace is a source and toolchain trace, not a target readout.

findings.what: NVIC_FPDSCR (offset 0x0f3c) is defined but referenced nowhere else in the traced NuttX directories or PX4
up_initial_state zeroes the initial context and sets regs[REG_FPSCR] = 0 under CONFIG_ARCH_FPU; the idle thread (pid 0) returns earlier and keeps the hardware reset FPSCR

REG_FPSCR is at SW_XCPT_REGS + 24, inside the hardware-stacked extended exception frame; with CONTROL.FPCA=1 and ASPEN=0 the processor pops S0-S15 and FPSCR from that frame on every exception return, so a task starts with the FPSCR value written at line 158 of arm_initialstate.c
software saves and restores only S16-S31; S0-S15 and FPSCR travel in the hardware frame; no vmsr
SYS_switch_context and SYS_restore_context select the next task register frame; FPSCR is restored by the exception return from that frame
every task (task_create path) and pthread (PX4 work-queue threads) passes through nxthread_setup_scheduler, which calls up_initial_state; nx_start calls it for the idle thread
vmrs (read) only; used by assert, coredump and gdbstub
longjmp restores the FPSCR that setjmp saved in the same context; it introduces no new bits

documentation_derived_not_source.fpdscr_reset_value: Arm Cortex-M7 Devices Generic User Guide (DUI 0646) lists FPDSCR with reset value 0x00000000; this trace did not read the register
documentation_derived_not_source.fpdscr_use: ARMv7-M Architecture Reference Manual (DDI 0403): the processor copies FPDSCR into FPSCR when it creates a new floating-point context under automatic state preservation (FPCCR.ASPEN=1); the pinned NuttX clears ASPEN, so FPDSCR is not consulted on this path even if it were nonzero
documentation_derived_not_source.extended_frame_restore: ARMv7-M Architecture Reference Manual (DDI 0403): exception return with an extended frame (EXC_RETURN bit 4 clear) restores S0-S15 and FPSCR from the stack when FPCCR.LSPEN=0
